# devcontainer-images

> Container images for developing and running the ivan-pinatti-labs
> repositories, built and scanned in CI and consumed by digest.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/devcontainer-images

## What it does

Carries one shared base image with the tooling every repository in the
organization needs (git, the GitHub CLI, pre-commit, a version manager and
the scanners), so work on those repositories happens inside a container
rather than on the host. A repository needing more than the base adds a thin
layer of its own on top. Images are built, linted, scanned and signed in CI,
published to the GitHub Container Registry, and consumed by digest so a
rebuild never changes what a repository builds against without a commit.

Nothing is published yet: this repository currently carries the scaffolding,
and the base image plus its build pipeline land next.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): Pitch, quickstart, and usage
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI coding agents and contributors,
  imported by [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)
- [docs/MERGE_PIPELINE.md](docs/MERGE_PIPELINE.md): How a pull request gets
  from opened to merged here
- [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml): The checklists and
  hooks every change runs through

## Tech stack

- Container images built and run with Podman (rootless), Docker compatible
- GitHub Actions for building, scanning, signing and publishing to GHCR
- pre-commit, hadolint, gitleaks and Trivy for the local and CI checks

## Conventions

- Conventional Commits for commit messages, no ticket prefix baked in
- pre-commit hooks wired up via
  [ivan-pinatti-labs/pre-commit-checklists](https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/pre-commit-checklists),
  see [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml)
